context: The Master System needs a reference implementation. The environment has Python 3.14.6 and jsonschema 4.26.0 installed, but no Node.js, npm or PyYAML.
problem: Which implementation language should the reference tooling use, without installing global software?
decision: Use Python 3 (standard library) with jsonschema for validation.
reason: It is the only robust option already available, avoids installing software (policy), and is well suited to schema validation and CLI tooling.
consequences: The reference implementation depends on Python and jsonschema. CORE and SCHEMAS remain language-neutral, so other implementations remain possible.
author: implementation-agent
